discussion_comments.comment_body:
Why special-case HTTP exceptions and have a separate dict for each status code?

Since `self.error_handler_spec` is already backwards-incompatible (as in, code that directly modifies it breaks), I think we can remove this distinction. I suppose that also eliminates the need for most of the code in `_ensure_exc_class`.
